connector.name: Helmdeck
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted MCP server: sandboxed browser, desktop, vision, code-edit packs for any agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-bridge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tosin2013 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HELMDECK_URL
env.description: Base URL of your helmdeck control plane (e.g. http://localhost:3000 for a local Compose install, or your reverse-proxied https URL)

env.name: HELMDECK_TOKEN
env.description: JWT bearer token minted from your helmdeck control plane. Generate with: curl -X POST $HELMDECK_URL/api/v1/auth/login -d '{"username":"admin","password":"..."}'

env.name: HELMDECK_URL
env.description: Base URL of your helmdeck control plane reachable from the container network (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:3000)

env.name: HELMDECK_TOKEN
env.description: JWT bearer token minted from your helmdeck control plane
